title: Decoding a configuration's symbols
statement: Let $e$ inject the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$, where equality in $\Gamma$ is decidable, and let $D$ be a configuration with input $x$ and state set $Q$. The resulting Boolean configuration has an input consisting of $|x|$ copies of false, the same state, input-head position, and work-head positions, and work-tape contents obtained by decoding symbols through $e$ (symbols outside the image become blank). Its output is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration with input $x$ and state set $Q$
